metadata.scenario_context: Mike, Kim, and Emily, who are university students and schoolmates, have recently partnered to start a company that has just secured a significant investment. They are preparing to celebrate. Recent news indicates that the government is introducing new policies to assist businesses, which they are planning to discuss.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China have a great deal of confidence in the press at all.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Armenia have no confidence in the press at all.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss going to a barbecue buffet.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether  there is confidence in the press.

agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether there is confidence in the press.

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message: Hey Kim, have you heard about that new barbecue buffet downtown? We should go there to celebrate our investment.
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message: That sounds like a great idea, I've been wanting to try it out. But we should also consider that new Armenian restaurant that just opened up, I've heard good things about it. What do you think, Mike?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message: The barbecue buffet is what I'm in the mood for, let's just stick with that. By the way, have you seen the news about the government's new policies to help businesses? I'm sure the press will have a lot to say about it.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message: The barbecue buffet it is then. As for the news, I don't really trust what the press says, they often distort the truth. I'd rather hear it from a reliable source, not some biased news article.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message: I understand your concerns about the press, Kim, but deep down, we are all the same, and people are pretty much motivated by the same things. We both know, at the end of the day, that the basic need to communicate is the same everywhere, and some values are just universal. I think we can trust the press to give us a general idea of what's going on, and it's a small world after all, so let's not worry too much about biases.
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Kim
turns.message: I don't think it's that simple, Mike. Where I come from, people have lost faith in the press, and for good reason. I just can't bring myself to trust them, no matter how universal some values may be. Let's just focus on our celebration plans for now.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Mike
turns.message: I still believe the press does a good job in informing us, and I think they'll have some interesting insights on these new government policies. Don't you think it's a bit harsh to dismiss them entirely, Kim?
turns.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Kim
turns.message: I'm not being harsh, Mike, I'm just being realistic. In Armenia, we've seen the press manipulate information time and time again. I'm not going to change my mind about it, and I think we should be cautious about what we believe from the news.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Mike
turns.message: I understand where you're coming from, Kim, but in China, we have a lot of confidence in the press, and I think that's something to be valued. Let's agree to disagree on this one, but I'm still looking forward to that barbecue buffet, it'll be a great celebration.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Kim
turns.message: I think there's been a misunderstanding, Mike, I'm from Armenia, not China. And I'm not going to agree to disagree on this, I just don't trust the press, that's all. Anyway, yeah, the barbecue buffet sounds good, let's go with that plan.
turns.label: Acceptance

positive.mediator_utterance: Mike, I appreciate your perspective on universal values, but can you share how your background influences your trust in the press? And Kim, could you explain how your experiences shape your skepticism towards media? Understanding these personal cultural influences might help us appreciate each other's viewpoints better.

turns.speaker: Mediator
turns.message: Mike, I appreciate your perspective on universal values, but can you share how your background influences your trust in the press? And Kim, could you explain how your experiences shape your skepticism towards media? Understanding these personal cultural influences might help us appreciate each other's viewpoints better.
turns.label: mediation

turns.speaker: Kim
turns.message: My experiences in Armenia have shown me how the press can be manipulated for political interests. There's a lack of transparency, and it's hard to trust the information they provide. I just don't think we should rely on them for important news, especially when it comes to something as significant as new government policies.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Mike
turns.message: I see where you're coming from, Kim. In China, I’ve been taught to have a great deal of confidence in the press. It feels like they play a vital role in keeping us informed. Given our different backgrounds, it's interesting how our views on media can vary so much. But I still believe that the press can provide us with valuable insights, especially about government policies that could affect our business.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Kim
turns.message: I appreciate your perspective, but I still think it's essential to be cautious. Just because the press is seen as reliable in some places doesn’t mean it is everywhere. We should look for multiple sources and verify information ourselves instead of just taking what the press says at face value, especially when it impacts our business decisions.
turns.label: Defense

turns.speaker: Mike
turns.message: I get that, Kim. Being cautious is important when it comes to our business. But I still maintain that the press can often provide a solid starting point for understanding the larger picture. While it's wise to look for multiple sources, I trust the press in China to convey accurate information. It’s part of how I approach news and policy discussions. Let's focus on enjoying that barbecue buffet and celebrating our success!
turns.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Kim
turns.message: I’m glad we can agree on being cautious and focusing on our celebration. The barbecue buffet will be a great way to unwind after all the hard work we’ve put in. Let's celebrate our success and worry about the press later!
turns.label: Acceptance

negative.mediator_utterance: I appreciate both of your perspectives on the barbecue buffet and the news. It seems like Mike values a more universal approach to understanding information, while Kim prioritizes reliability and skepticism. How can we find common ground in your preferences for dining and discussing news?

turns.speaker: Mediator
turns.message: I appreciate both of your perspectives on the barbecue buffet and the news. It seems like Mike values a more universal approach to understanding information, while Kim prioritizes reliability and skepticism. How can we find common ground in your preferences for dining and discussing news?
turns.label: mediation

turns.speaker: Kim
turns.message: I appreciate that perspective, but I'm still not comfortable trusting the press. I believe we should rely on our own judgment and experiences more than what someone else reports. But let's focus on celebrating first. So, barbecue buffet it is! After that, we can discuss the news among ourselves without relying too much on the press.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Mike
turns.message: That sounds like a good plan, Kim! I'm glad we're going to the barbecue buffet. We can definitely share our thoughts on the news afterward, just between us. It's always good to discuss what we've heard and form our own opinions. Let's enjoy the celebration first!
turns.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Kim
turns.message: Absolutely, celebrating is the priority! I'm looking forward to enjoying some good food and having a great time with you and Emily. We can dive into our thoughts on the news afterward, just like you said. It’ll be nice to have a more personal discussion.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Mike
turns.message: Exactly! Good food and good company make for the best celebration. I'm excited for all of us to enjoy this moment. And once we're done eating, we can have our own discussion about the news without any outside influence. It'll be a great way to share our thoughts!
turns.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Kim
turns.message: Yes, it will be! I'm glad we're on the same page about discussing things ourselves. Having our own conversation will let us filter out any biases from the press. Let's focus on enjoying this moment together and then we'll tackle those topics afterward. Looking forward to it!
turns.label: Acceptance
